segments.notes: Pepito assumes mayoral office in Rennerton, bulldozes schools and hospitals, holds press conference, wins re-election as 'despotic dog' before transitioning to Kasem G administration.
segments.title: The Pepito Administration: Year Zero

segments.notes: Kasem G elected mayor; builds horse-slaughter sneaker economy, bulldozes stadiums, adds hospitals, faces press scrutiny over water filtration and drug policy, survives challenge from Crum.
segments.title: The Kasem G Era: Industrial Pivot

segments.notes: Case Blackwell briefly interrupts broadcast to confirm stream continuity ahead of Kasem G campaign rally.
segments.title: Blackwell Live Check-In

segments.notes: Crum elected mayor; institutes taxation, expands hospital row, reduces casinos, reaches 559k citizens, withstands hostile press conference with Munch infiltration and fart-podium incident.
segments.title: The Crum Administration: Civic Reform

segments.notes: Crum wins re-election over Munch in close race; Munch delivers unhinged concession rap vowing return, Crum pledges eight more years of 'solutions not prostitution'.
segments.title: Crum Re-Election & Munch Meltdown

segments.notes: Chet elected mayor on science platform; delivers teleportation-infused campaign rap, advocates opening sneakers without horse slaughter, promises AI-controlled city management.
segments.title: The Chet Administration: Science Ticket

segments.notes: Peter Gibbon wins final election after Munch endorses him; Crum concedes citing Munch's memoir paywall, Gibbon takes office promising to repair Rennerton, stream ends with raid to Bruce Green.
segments.title: Gibbon Victory & Handoff

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Opens broadcast as 'Papita', serves as first mayor of Renerton, bulldozes schools/hospitals, wins re-election as dog incumbent.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Serves two mayoral terms, implements taxes and hospitals, survives hostile press conference, wins re-election over Munch.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Runs in multiple elections, infiltrates Crum's press conference, delivers unhinged concession rap after losing re-election bid.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: science correspondent. Elected mayor on science platform, campaigns on teleportation tech and ending horse slaughter for sneakers.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Appears as 'Lady Kendall' and 'Lady Ken Doll' ghost candidate across multiple election cycles.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: cultural correspondent. Runs as mayoral candidate, engages in press conference banter, trails in polls.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News returns to the municipal simulator Renerton for a marathon session spanning seven mayoral administrations across 134 simulated years. Executive producer Pepito opens as a canine strongman before yielding to a parade of network personalities — Kasem G, Crum, Chet, and finally Peter Gibbon — each reshaping the city through bulldozer governance, casino economies, and escalating hospital crises. The broadcast culminates in Gibbon's victory and a handoff to a noon continuation stream.
